personality_one_liner: A clinical, highly readable, and zero-friction tracking interface that prioritizes immediate data entry and clear status visibility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for forms. Safe-area clearance is mandatory. Use md (12) for inner component padding and lg (16) for screen edges.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass for sticky sticky headers over the history timeline.
Apply to the floating 'Esporta PDF' button container if pinned over scrolling content.
dont's: Never blur standard form inputs or list rows.
Avoid applying glassmorphism to data cards inside the timeline.

screens.name: Inserimento (Home)
screens.purpose: Rapid, single-screen logging of glucose, insulin, and meal context with immediate visual feedback on thresholds.

states.loading: Centered spinner (rare, mostly instantaneous local storage).
states.empty: N/A - This is always an actionable form.
states.error: Inline validation messages below the glucose input if value is impossible.

screens.layout: Screen opens directly to this form. Top section: abstract medical blue header with current Date & Time pickers. Center: Massive numeric input for 'Glicemia (mg/dL)'. The text color of this input changes dynamically (Red if >180, Orange if <70, Green/Default if normal) for instant feedback. Below: Insulin units (numeric stepper or compact input). Next section: 9 Meal Moments rendered as a wrapping flex-row of pill-shaped chips (brandTertiary when selected, surfaceSecondary when inactive). Bottom: Optional text input for 'Note alimentari'. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom 'Salva Misurazione', anchored above the keyboard using KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Storico
screens.purpose: A clear, stacked timeline of all historical measurements grouped by day, with a quick export function.

states.loading: Skeleton lines mimicking the timeline structure.
states.empty: Clean clipboard illustration centered with text 'Nessuna misurazione registrata' and CTA 'Aggiungi ora'.
states.error: Readable error message with a retry button to reload local data.

screens.layout: Header: Title 'Storico' and a prominent 'Esporta in PDF' button. Body: SectionList grouped by Date. Each row uses a stacked timeline layout: a vertical line with a colored dot on the left (Red for high, Orange for low, Green for normal glucose) connecting to a data card. The data card (surfaceSecondary) contains the Glucose value (large text in Space Grotesk), Insulin units, Meal moment icon/text, and optional notes. Generous bottom padding to allow scrolling past the tab bar.

header_abstract_medical.alt: Soft abstract medical blue and white flowing background for the header

empty_clipboard.alt: Clean clipboard representing an empty medical history state

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for iOS (iPhone optimized) natively, do not build web-based UI paradigms. No hover states.
Implement both Light and Dark mode strictly using the provided color tokens in the JSON.
On the 'Inserimento' screen, dynamically color the Glucose text input based on the value (<70 warning/orange, >180 error/red).
Use a wrapping flex-row of pill chips (flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8) for the 9 meal moments. Do not use a native picker as it takes too many taps.
The timeline in the 'Storico' screen must have visual connecting lines between items of the same day. Use the status colors (warning, error, success) for the timeline dots.
PDF Export must generate a landscape PDF with a professional 10-column nested header table, as explicitly requested by the user. Use expo-print and expo-sharing.
Keep navigation to Bottom Tabs: 'Inserisci' and 'Storico'. The app must default to the 'Inserisci' tab on launch.
